## Activity

During January 2021, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 25 captures. This provides the activity total for the reporting month and represents the number of captures completed at the site. The activity figure is reported alongside image quality and grading outcomes to support routine review of site operations.

## Image quality

Of the 25 captures, 6 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 24.0. This result identifies the proportion of captures that could not be used for grading during January 2021. Image quality is reported separately from the overall capture total to distinguish completed activity from images available for assessment.

## Grading

Grading identified 2 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 1. This measure provides the central value for the time between capture and completion of grading. Together, the grading result and median lag summarise the reported assessment outcome and timeliness for Hill Counties Health Centre in January 2021.
